2.subject: Pixel made it into the podcast room
2.preview: 14 minutes on making a week of posts without a design app.
paras: New episode of The Robot Break Room is up.

This week Boot sits down with Pixel, my graphics robot. They get into how I make a whole week of posts without ever opening a design app: one brand file, a sentence in plain words, and a quick check on my phone.
Pixel also tells everybody about the poster with six fonts. Rude. Accurate, but rude.
It's 14 minutes. Good for a walk.
